source: 国土交通省 PLATEAU 岡崎市 2020年度 建築物LOD1

coreExcluded.method: Original six-quarter-mesh rectangle; building centroid exclusion

geometryFormat: region-building-v1: positions Int16 XYZ then normals normalized Int8 XYZ then pad to 4 byte alignment then indices Uint32; origin+scale; welded by quantized position and flat normal

heightCorrection.method: Bilinear interpolation; ellipsoidal height minus geoid height = orthometric height
